_audit_note: Every declaration below is bound to source file evidence. Last audited: 2026-08-30. Auditor: AGENT D.

data_shared.description: Subject public record identifiers and actionability purpose codes are sent to the app's own PV API server when the operator performs a trust lookup, actionability evaluation, or reliance receipt creation. This data identifies gemstone/asset records being queried, not the end-user.

data_collected.description: The last 10 subject public IDs entered by the operator are stored locally on-device in encrypted storage. This data is NEVER transmitted to any server.

Reliance receipts generated by the app are stored locally in encrypted storage (Android EncryptedSharedPreferences). Server-issued receipts originate from the PV server but are stored locally after receipt. Data is NOT shared with third parties.
data_collected.encrypted_in_transit: N/A — local storage only; server-issued receipts are received over HTTPS

data_NOT_collected_or_shared: Name, email, phone number, physical address
Photos or videos (camera frames are processed on-device; not stored or transmitted)
Advertising ID or other device identifiers (no device_info plugin; no IDFA/GAID access)
Crash logs or diagnostic data (no crash reporting SDK in pubspec.lock)
Analytics or performance data (no analytics SDK)
User credentials (API key is baked in at build time via --dart-define; not collected from users)

security_practices.encryption_in_transit_note: All API calls use HTTPS (TLS). Base URL: provenance-verified-private.vercel.app. See lib/core/network/api_client.dart; lib/core/config/environment.dart.
security_practices.encryption_at_rest_note: Android: EncryptedSharedPreferences (AES-256 key wrapped via Android Keystore). iOS: flutter_secure_storage uses Keychain with kSecAttrAccessibleAfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly. See lib/core/storage/secure_storage.dart:4-11.
security_practices.data_deletion_note: Receipts and search history can be deleted within the app (deleteReceipt, evict functions). No server-side user account to delete since there is no per-user login.
security_practices.committed_to_play_families_policy_note: App is a B2B operator tool; not directed at children.

CAMERA.purpose: QR code scanning for record lookup

INTERNET.purpose: API calls to PV backend (trust lookup, actionability, reliance receipt creation)

USE_BIOMETRIC.purpose: Biometric unlock for secure storage (flutter_secure_storage Android Keystore unlock)
